zh-CN: Air75 V3 新增 USB 侧灯状态模式，可与背光模式切换。
侧灯跟踪当前任务集合，仅在完整、新鲜的成功状态下显示全部完成。
侧灯模式释放任务键，命令键可独立开关，原有映射与内容保留。
支持 Air75 V3 官方 2.0.0.7 的 USB 灯控与功能键，并提供升级后临时 F4 键位的确认恢复。
固件提醒仅建议已完成 Lab 兼容验证的版本；保留原设置，并提示配套接收器更新。
新固件下，无法确认能原样恢复的主灯颜色或已有自定义灯效会先停止接管；侧灯仍可使用。
功能中心新增 Dock 场景，可保存原始固定应用顺序，通过自定义快捷键切换场景。
en: Air75 V3 adds USB side-LED status mode alongside backlighting.
Side LEDs track the current task cohort; all-complete requires a fresh, complete set of successful results.
Side mode releases task keys and provides a separate command-key switch while preserving mappings and content.
Supports USB lighting and function keys on Air75 V3 firmware 2.0.0.7, with confirmed recovery of a temporary F4 assignment after upgrading.
Firmware prompts recommend only Lab-qualified releases, preserve current settings, and explain matching receiver updates.
On the new firmware, backlight control pauses before changing a main color or existing custom effect that cannot be restored exactly. Side lighting remains available.
Dock Scenes saves your original pinned apps and lets you switch between layouts with configurable shortcuts.
